invariants.rationale: cursorPatch is dereferenced and has its draw method called.
batch is passed to cursorPatch.draw as a required argument.
font is used to access font.getDescent() and font.getData().cursorX, requiring it to be non-null.
The x position plus font offset may often be expected to be non-negative when drawing UI elements.
The adjusted y coordinate (accounting for font descent) could be constrained by UI layout expectations.
